patch_description:
Replace the unstructured Gaussian sample with a deterministic multi-start optimization for a 7-line packing in three dimensions.  Representing each line by an antipodal pair gives exactly 14 points and guarantees a maximum distance of 2 after normalization.  The remaining objective is then to minimize the largest absolute dot product between distinct line directions, which directly maximizes the evaluator's squared minimum/maximum distance ratio.

The edit uses batched Riesz-repulsion continuation to obtain diverse high-quality configurations, retains the strongest candidates, and applies a small greedy tangent-space polish using the exact line-packing objective.  All random generation uses a local fixed-seed generator, preserving reproducibility without modifying global NumPy random state.
